criteria.description: New test runs under 2 s, median of five, uptime recorded, in QA report
criteria.note: Bound: under 2 s. The record gives five runs (0.412, 0.428, 0.448, 0.511, 0.530) with a median of 0.448 s, which is correct. Load is 0.98 / 2.56 / 5.54, read before each run. The command is wall clock around node --test via process.hrtime. The figure was taken at 085c54e6a, which is tree-equivalent to head. Running finalise-delta.js docs-only --base 144f2a1dd --head HEAD returned reason tree-equivalent (exit 0), changing only task docs and the gate and QA files. The same check with --base 085c54e6a returned tree-equivalent, with only qa.3.md changed. So: measured on 085c54e6a, tree-equivalent to head. My own run showed duration_ms 605, also under the bound. Weak point: the load is stated once as identical across runs, not shown beside each run.
